summary: V496 keeps Lift lending dark-launched (Enabled defaults false) and locks Jacob book/APR economics: short-book outstanding α ≤ 15% of pool α (sudo 1–50%); long-book outstanding borrowed TAO ≤ 15% of SubnetTAO (same bounds); Cap_short back to 1× (split_short_bps 5000). Short APR tracks utilization U with a kinked curve (20% flat to U=0.5, then to 100% at U=1), applied live at each accrual (O(1)); interest still burned. Also ships add_collateral, roll collateral adequacy, and spot-relative forced buyback progress from the lending tip. Regenerate metadata before integrating.
